title: Shift run encodes shifted gates
statement: For every natural number $m$ and finite list $g_s$ of algebraic gates, applying the shift run to the pairing of the unary string of length $m$ with the gate-list encoding yields the concatenation, in order, of the bit $1$ followed by the encoding of each gate after shifting its node references by $m$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of algebraic gates
